Near anatomical LEFT arm remains EMPTY hanging lower-LEFT, with a continuous shoulder→upperarm→elbow→forearm→empty hand. Exactly TWO arms/shoulders/hands and ONE sword total.

CRITICAL ANATOMY EDIT: the existing far anatomical RIGHT arm is ALREADY RAISED holding the sword. Move and bend ONLY THIS EXISTING RAISED WEAPON ARM into a deeper loaded windup. The raised hand/sword replace their old position, they do NOT duplicate. The farRIGHT side below the raised arm contains only torso/hip/cape/leg, NO spare hanging hand. Preserve the separate nearLEFT empty hanging arm exactly as the only free arm.

Make a distinct physical loaded phase2, not a duplicate of phase1: slightly deeper torso crouch and counter-rotation while still facing NW, shoulders gather under the raised original weapon, knees flex and weight compresses coherently. Wings adjust slightly backward for balance and cape follows with slight delayed fold. Keep body/head/gear proportions and original wing fan construction; no new ornaments, shortened blade, replacement weapon, extra wing, changed helmet or armor. Show every complete connected part, including full sword tip, both fan tips, all cape and both boots.

Entire complete silhouette fits within a640px square at center with at least192px alpha0 gutter each side. Body and equipment share one uniform scale. If resolution differs, do not distort body or shorten gear. Opaque armor/crystal/cape and crisp internal gold detail, clean1–2px edge antialiasing. All purple light stays INSIDE original hard opaque feather/crystal blade surfaces. No external glow, shadow, floor, halo, aura, fog, blur, trails, text, labels, grid or background.
